sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commissioner Against Corruption analysed local government responses to the Public Integrity Survey 2018.
sentences.support:
This report focusses on local government data gathered in my Public Integrity 
Survey 2018.

sentences.text: The survey examined perceptions of corruption risks, workplace conduct and reporting, without establishing findings about individual councils.
sentences.support:
It is not possible to offer specific findings in respect of individual 
Councils.

sentences.text: The Commissioner reported that council respondents were often more positive than the wider sample but raised concerns about reporting protections and reprisals.
sentences.support:
There was a common theme surrounding the inadequacy of 
protections offered to those who wanted to make a report

sentences.text: The Commissioner encouraged councils to improve reporting training, review information access and conflict controls, and check recruitment qualifications.
sentences.support:
Councils are encouraged to review 
their processes and controls to ensure conflicts are identified and managed in 
accordance with the Local Government Act 1999.

findings.quote: While awareness of ICAC / OPI was high there remains a need for ongoing training.

notes: Recommendations are unnumbered. Participant accounts and perceptions are not treated as established misconduct findings.
